title: Claude structured-output escalation: latency, agreement with Jev

out.rationale: The hedge is fully covered with both legs at safe liquidation distances, funding is neutral, and the hedge is only minutes old, so any change would add risk and cost without a clear benefit. Reserve margin is thin and volatility is elevated, so avoid actions like adding to the short leg or taking profit on one leg that would unbalance the hedge and expose the remaining leg.
